hard_rules: Channels may not create claims absent from the candidate claim registry.
Every derived asset records source ids, snapshot id, transform owner, content hash, and review state.
A broader channel claim invalidates the package.
Changed support evidence returns downstream assets to evidence_bound.
English and Chinese claim variants require parity review.
V3 candidate assets must bind audience, channel, locale, semantic version, transform producer, source-node hashes, review IDs and retained limitations, or explicitly record NotApplicable.
V3 draft package validation rejects source candidate/snapshot/hash drift, omitted retained limitations, and bilingual localization without parity review.

v3_private_staging.boundary: v3 validates private draft relationships only; it cannot publish, schedule, send, or authorize a channel package.
